Confirmed from protocol.d.ts ProcessInfo (id is chrome-internal, type 'browser'), and launchProcess spawn pid at 9300/9323 is real OS PID.

2) PID reuse: verify owned candidate via exe path + create_time + parent + commandline containing unique user-data-dir.

3) filechooser listener removal: ChannelOwner.off/removeListener calls _updateSubscription(event,false) → fire-and-forget `this._channel.updateSubscription(...).catch(()=>{})` at 57282 — not awaited. On server side updateSubscription (53668-53675) → setFileChooserInterceptedBy → _setFileChooserInterceptedBy deletes 'by', if changed calls delegate.updateFileChooserInterception → _updateFileChooserInterception sends Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog {enabled:false} (38026-38031). Also note Playwright Page event mapping for fileChooser isn't in the shown context mappings (context map shown only). Explicit await page._channel.updateSubscription({event:'fileChooser',enabled:false}) is plausible—protocol event name 'fileChooser' confirmed at 53669. Plus belt-and-braces CDP Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog {enabled:false}. Caveat: CDP disable would also disable if other interceptors... setInterceptFileChooserDialog is per-session; Playwright may re-enable. Note: clicking #btn-import may open native dialog natively once interception off.

Also harness has a listener via waitForEvent('filechooser') in t.importSaved — once() auto-removes, triggering off→updateSubscription false async; race with dialog opening means native dialog may appear while interception still on... actually for step11 the concern is interception still enabled when native dialog opens — Playwright intercept prevents native dialog? Actually interception intercepts and shows no native dialog; if still intercepted, native cancel helper finds no dialog → DIALOG_NOT_FOUND. That's the diagnosis: leftover interception due to async un-awaited updateSubscription.

Interception patch snippet: after prerequisite import, explicitly:
```js
await page._channel.updateSubscription({event:'fileChooser', enabled:false}).catch(()=>{});
const cdpPage = await ctx.newCDPSession(page);
await cdpPage.send('Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog',{enabled:false}).catch(()=>{});
```
Verify mapping: need Page `_setEventToSubscriptionMapping` for fileChooser — not in supplied excerpts; mark hypothesis, request range around Page channel owner constructor (~62700s? unknown). Flag as needed.

Risks: PID reuse window, _channel private API, CDP session overrides, race between updateSubscription server-side and click.

Live PID mapping snippet in step11: use browser process pid — but playwright doesn't expose launchedProcess. Options: t.page.context().browser() — no pid exposed publicly. Propose: record from spawn is internal to playwright; alternative: verify CDP pid via WMI: query only that pid's ExecutablePath/CreationDate/ParentProcessId/CommandLine and require CommandLine contains `--user-data-dir=<OUT>\profile` and exe ends chrome.exe and parent chain — matches harness launch. If mismatch, treat as stale/reused.
